SQL:
WITH RECURSIVE order_lines AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS line_seq
    FROM orderlines 
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
product_inventory AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, ol.order_qty,
           i.location_id, i.qty AS inv_qty, i.purchase_id,
           l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id 
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty
           ) AS rn
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN inventory i ON ol.product_id = i.product_id
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY rn) as rn_num
    FROM product_inventory
),
rec_calc(product_id, rn_num, inv_qty, aisle, position, location_id, purchased, rn, order_qty, prev_pick_total, pick_qty) AS (
    SELECT r.product_id, r.rn_num, r.inv_qty, r.aisle, r.position, r.location_id, r.purchased, r.rn, r.order_qty, 0, LEAST(r.inv_qty, r.order_qty)
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn_num = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.product_id, r.rn_num, r.inv_qty, r.aisle, r.position, r.location_id, r.purchased, r.rn, r.order_qty, 
           COALESCE(prev_pick_total + pick_qty, 0),
           LEAST(r.inv_qty, COALESCE(r.order_qty - (prev_pick_total + pick_qty), 0))
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN rec_calc rc ON r.product_id = rc.product_id AND r.rn_num = rc

    FROM inventory i

    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    JOIN order_qty o ON i.product_id = o.product_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1

    SELECT 
        *,

picked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_cum_inv_qty IS NULL OR prev_cum_inv_qty < order_qty_needed
            THEN LEAST(inv_qty, order_qty_needed - prev_cum_inv_qty)
            ELSE 0
        END as picked_qty
    FROM with_prev
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, picked_qty
